description:
VELOCI ROAD PLUS is built for riders who want the speed and responsiveness of a road bike without being limited to perfect pavement. Designed for mixed surfaces and longer rides, it feels equally at home on smooth tarmac, rough backroads, and light gravel routes.

The frame uses MKT seamless heat-treated double- and triple-butted chromoly tubing, giving ROAD PLUS a balanced ride feel with the stiffness needed for efficient pedaling while still keeping the natural comfort steel is known for.

Generous tire clearance for up to 700x32C or 650Bx42C tires allows more freedom to tune the bike for different riding styles and terrain. Whether you prefer a fast all-road setup or something more capable for rougher surfaces, ROAD PLUS adapts easily.

Flat-mount disc brakes provide clean integration with reliable braking performance in all weather conditions, especially during long descents and unpredictable road surfaces. Heat-treated chainstays help improve power transfer while keeping the bike stable and composed under effort.

Extra mounts on the VELOCI No.55 Plus fork and top tube make the bike ready for light touring, commuting, or spontaneous detours off the main road without overcomplicating the setup.

Custom frame details, investment-cast components, and ED coating inside and out help combine classic steel bike character with modern function and long-term durability.

Fast, practical, and versatile, ROAD PLUS is made for riders who don't always want to stop where the pavement ends.

Frame weight: 2010g ( S size)
Shimano Di2 routing compatible
